title: The Dendera Light Relief
hook: Why does an ancient Egyptian wall look like a modern bulb?
headline: Ancient Egyptian 'Light Bulb' Mystery

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In the 1st century BCE, artisans carved a bulb-like scene in Dendera.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The relief shows a figure holding a rope attached to a luminous object.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Early 20th-century Egyptologists described it as a torch or electric lamp.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Recent analysis suggests the object could be a lotus-shaped oil lamp, not electricity.

end.line: What powered the ancient Dendera light in the temple?

description: Explore the mysterious Dendera relief that some claim depicts an ancient light bulb.
